1.why: The interface uses a clean sans-serif typeface with generous letter and line spacing across all screens.

2.why: Instructions are presented in clear sentence case without using italics, all-caps text, or dense text blocks.

3.why: The single-column layout is cleanly structured and well suited for mobile screen dimensions.

4.why: All instructions are concise, direct, and written in plain language.

5.why: Placeholder text provides clear examples of expected input formats for the phone number and recovery code fields.

6.why: User instructions on each step are limited to short, one- or two-sentence copy blocks.

7.why: The manual setup secret and backup recovery codes are displayed as plain text without dedicated copy-to-clipboard buttons.

8.why: The setup process only provides a manual text secret and completely lacks a QR code alternative.

9.why: Standard single-box input fields are used for codes and credentials, supporting native browser autofill.

10.why: Distinct page headers and prominent full-width blue buttons clearly highlight the current step and primary action.

11.why: Each screen focuses on a single primary task, such as entering a code or confirming code storage.

12.why: Success banners (e.g., 'Setup secret generated', 'Enrolment confirmed') clearly inform the user of completed actions and next steps.

13.why: Users can navigate back to previous setup stages or request replacement recovery codes at any time.

14.why: No error conditions or error messages are shown in any of the provided application screens.

15.why: There are no visible countdown timers or strict reading time limits enforced anywhere in the process.
